QF.id: IV Code of Conduct and Investor Protection_6

question.text: The Investor Protection Fund (IPF) is maintained by:

explanation.text: The Logic: The IPF is set up by Stock Exchanges and is established and maintained by the Exchanges. Each exchange maintains its own IPF to compensate eligible investors who suffer losses arising from the default of a trading member. The Trap: The Central Government stipulated setting up the IPF by Stock Exchanges, and SEBI provides comprehensive guidelines on its operation; RBI and the Ministry of Finance are not the maintainers. Note: The IPF mechanism is governed by SEBI's comprehensive IPF guidelines while being operated by the Exchanges themselves.
